simple.meaning: זְוָעָה (zᵉvâʻâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “agitation , fear.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 7 times across 2 Chronicles, Isaiah, Jeremiah, beginning at 2 Chronicles 29:8. Its contexts include family, family line, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to זְוָעָה (H2113).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: זְוָעָה (zᵉvâʻâh) / H2113 is traced through 2 Chronicles 29:8, Isaiah 28:19, Jeremiah 15:4, Jeremiah 24:9 as a generated source-based concept entry.

firstOccurrence.englishText: Therefore Yahweh’s wrath was on Judah and Jerusalem, and he has delivered them to be tossed back and forth, to be an astonishment, and a hissing, as you see with your eyes.

timeline.evidenceText: Therefore Yahweh’s wrath was on Judah and Jerusalem, and he has delivered them to be tossed back and forth, to be an astonishment, and a hissing, as you see with your eyes.
As often as it passes through, it will seize you; for morning by morning it will pass through, by day and by night; and it will be nothing but terror to understand the message.”
I will cause them to be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth, because of Manasseh, the son of Hezekiah, king of Judah, for that which he did in Jerusalem.
I will even give them up to be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth for evil; to be a reproach and a proverb, a taunt and a curse, in all places where I will drive them.
I will even give them up to be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth for evil; to be a reproach and a proverb, a taunt and a curse, in all places where I will drive them.

I will pursue after them with the sword, with the famine, and with the pestilence, and will deliver them to be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth, to be an object of horror, an astonishment, a hissing, and a reproach among all the nations where I have driven them,

Therefore Yahweh says: “You have not listened to me, to proclaim liberty, every man to his brother, and every man to his neighbor. Behold, I proclaim to you a liberty,” says Yahweh, “to the sword, to the pestilence, and to the famine. I will make you be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth.

definitions.full: H2113. zevaah זְוָעָה and, by transposition, זַעֲוָה (Di Deut 28:25 compare Sta § 192 a ) noun feminine a trembling , i.e. object of trembling, terror : זְוָעָה Isa 28:19 , also Kt Jer 15:4 4 t.; זַעֲוָה Deut 28:25 ; Ezek 23:46 (also Qr Jer 15:4 4 t.); — object of trembling, terror, fright ; לְזַעֲוָה זְהָיִיתָ Deut 28:25 and thou shalt become a terror to all ( לְכֹל ) the kingdoms of the earth; לְז ׳וּנְתַתִּים ׳וגו ) Jer 15:4 ; 29:18 ; 34:17 (|| וּלְשַׁמָּה לְאָלָה וּלְחֶרְמָּה וְלִשְׁרֵקָה ) also לְז ׳וּנְתַתִּים ׳וגו 24:9 (|| לְחֶרְמָּה וְלִקְלָלָה לִשְׁנִינָה וּלְמָשָׁל ), Ezek 23:46 ; 2Chr 29:8 .
